terms.content: Welcome to the website https://radio.eplus.dev ("Radio ePlus") a product by ePlus.DEV. Please carefully read the Agreement on provision and use of services on the Website https://radio.eplus.dev before you use the features on the "Radio." Website ePlus. Once registered, you have read, understood, accepted and complied with the terms below:

article_1.title: Article 1: Nonprofit
article_1.line_1: We are committed to free forever, with no fees of any kind.
article_1.line_2: We recognize the use of free content from all over the station, content developers from all over the world, so I wanted to spread this content to everyone.

article_2.title: Article 2: Digital Millennium Copyright Act
article_2.line_1: Radio ePlus takes matters of Intellectual Property very seriously and is committed to meeting the needs of content owners while helping them manage publication of their content online. It should be noted that Radio ePlus is a radio station portal linking to third party websites by pop ups.
article_2.line_2: Any content on these third party websites are the responsibility of those sites and not Radio ePlus. We have no knowledge of whether content on third party websites is or is not authorized by the content owner as that is a matter between the site that hosts the audio content and the content owner. Radio ePlus does not host any audio content on its servers or network.

about.title: About Radio ePlus
about.description: A lightweight directory and player for discovering live internet radio by region and country.

discover.title: Discover radio
discover.body: Radio ePlus organizes internet radio stations by region and country so listeners can find local and international stations from one consistent interface.

playback.title: Direct playback
playback.body: The player connects your browser to station or provider streams and supports common audio and HLS sources with bounded fallback handling.

availability.title: Live data changes
availability.body: Station streams, schedules, artwork and current-song data come from changing catalogs and third-party providers, so availability can change without notice.

open_source.title: Open project
open_source.body: Radio ePlus is maintained by ePlus.DEV. The application source, issues and ongoing improvements are available publicly on GitHub.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How Radio ePlus handles site preferences, search, playback requests and third-party services.

accounts.title: Accounts and payments
accounts.body: Radio ePlus does not require a user account and does not provide a payment or checkout flow on this website. Please do not submit sensitive personal information through public project channels.

preferences.title: Local preferences
preferences.body: Theme, language and similar interface preferences may be stored by your browser or by framework cookies/local storage so the site can remember your choices.

search.title: Search services
search.body: When site search is enabled, search queries may be processed by the configured search provider such as Algolia. Their own privacy terms apply to that processing.

streams.title: Radio streams and third parties
streams.body: Starting playback connects your browser to radio stations, streaming hosts, schedule providers or configured relay services. Those third parties can receive normal network information such as your IP address and user agent.

logs.title: Hosting and technical logs
logs.body: Hosting, CDN and security infrastructure may process standard request metadata needed to deliver, secure and troubleshoot the website, such as IP address, browser information, requested path and timestamps.

sharing.title: Sale and sharing of data
sharing.body: Radio ePlus does not sell personal data. Information is only processed as needed to operate the website or by the third-party services you directly use through search, playback or external links.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
changes.body: This policy may be updated when the website, providers or data practices change. The current version and update date are published on this page.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.description: The conditions for using Radio ePlus and its links to third-party radio services.

service.title: Use of the service
service.body: Radio ePlus is provided as a free radio discovery and playback interface. You may use the website for lawful personal access to publicly reachable radio services.

third_party.title: Third-party streams
third_party.body: Radio ePlus catalogs and links to streams operated by third parties. Those services control their own content, availability, geographic restrictions, advertising and terms. Radio ePlus does not guarantee that any stream will remain available.

copyright.title: Copyright and trademarks
copyright.body: Station names, logos, audio and other third-party materials remain the property of their respective owners. If you are a rights holder and believe a listing should be corrected or removed, contact the project with the affected URL and supporting information.

acceptable_use.title: Acceptable use
acceptable_use.body: Do not use Radio ePlus to abuse providers, bypass access controls, disrupt the service, scrape at harmful rates, distribute malware or violate applicable law or third-party rights.

availability.title: Availability and warranty
availability.body: The website and catalog are provided on an as-is and as-available basis. Stream quality, schedules, metadata and provider APIs can change or fail independently of Radio ePlus.

changes.title: Changes to these terms
changes.body: These terms may be updated as the project or supported services evolve. Continued use after an update means you are using the service under the current published terms.

contact.title: Contact Radio ePlus
contact.description: Report a bug, request a station update or contact the project about a rights-related listing.

bug.title: Bug or playback problem
bug.body: Include the affected page URL, browser/device, what you expected and what happened. Network or console details are helpful when a stream fails.

station.title: Station update
station.body: For a new station or metadata correction, provide the station name, official website, country and a verified public stream URL when available.

copyright.title: Copyright or removal
copyright.body: Rights holders can request a correction or removal by identifying the affected station/page and providing enough information for the project to verify the request.

github.title: Open a GitHub issue
github.body: Public development, bug reports and catalog corrections are tracked in the Radio ePlus GitHub repository.

statistics.title: Radio statistics
statistics.description: A build-time snapshot of the regions, countries and station entries currently available in the Radio ePlus catalog.
statistics.coverage_description: Each card shows how many country catalogs and station entries are currently stored for that region.
statistics.method_body: These figures are counted from the version-controlled JSON catalogs in the repository during the site build. They describe catalog entries, not guaranteed currently-online streams, unique broadcasters or audience size.
